name: The Utopia Studio
summary: The default locked theme for The Utopia Studio. It maps the Ceramic semantic contract to the studio's brand primitives while keeping those decisions out of reusable core components.

wordmark.usage: May identify The Utopia Studio branded products, documents, and template surfaces. Core components must not depend on this asset.

typography.arabicDisplayRule: Do not translate Latin all-caps styling into Arabic uppercase. Use Arabic display scale, weight, rhythm, and Readex Pro instead.

geometry.elevation: hairline borders and background shifts; no brand-surface drop shadows

semanticMappings.--primary: Accessible Brick Red action tone (#B8472C); preserve #CC5536 as the brand primitive
semanticMappings.--overlay: Special Black at modal dim opacity

allow: solid Special Black, Light Grey, Brick Red, and White surfaces
editorial whitespace that isolates one dominant message
full-bleed brand panels that alternate dark, accent, and light colourways
avoid: uniform card grids with equal visual weight
using Brick Red for small body copy when contrast is insufficient

visualGrammar.thesis: The interface should feel authored by a brand studio before it feels like a generic software dashboard.
composition: Give every page one dominant typographic entry point.
Use asymmetric whitespace and offset alignment instead of centering every block.
Alternate Special Black, Brick Red, and Light Grey as large editorial fields; do not reduce them to small UI accents.
Use boxes only when containment communicates function. Prefer rules, fields, and spacing for editorial grouping.
typography: Latin display headlines use TWK Lausanne 700, uppercase, tight line-height, and compact tracking.
Korean and Arabic retain native casing; Arabic uses Readex Pro at a lighter weight (300 body, 500 display) and a wider line-height to match the same visual mass as the Latin rhythm.
Small labels are concise, medium-weight, and widely tracked; body copy remains calm and readable.
signature: Use the three-bar mark as punctuation at major page entries, never as repeated decoration.
Use a Brick Red full stop or short rule to terminate key Latin headlines.
interaction: Active navigation is expressed with a Brick Red rule and stronger text, not a soft grey pill.
Hover states shift fields or rules directly; avoid floating card shadows and playful bounce.
Motion is deliberate, planar, and ceremonial with short directional travel.
accessibility: Brick Red on Special Black is a graphic accent only, not normal-size body text.
White on Brick Red is reserved for large or strong text; smaller copy uses the deep brand ink token with verified contrast.
Functional focus rings use the accessible ring token even when the graphic brand accent differs.

iconPolicy.description: Use Phosphor Icons for interface actions and navigation. The Utopia dot-and-bar graphic remains a brand mark, not a component icon.
iconPolicy.coreNote: Phosphor is selected by the Utopia Default theme. Core components remain icon-system neutral.

ar.summary: الثيم الافتراضي المقفل لـ The Utopia Studio. يربط عقد Ceramic الدلالي بقيم الاستوديو الأولية مع إبقاء قرارات العلامة خارج مكونات الجوهر القابلة لإعادة الاستخدام.

iconPolicy.description: استخدم أيقونات Phosphor لإجراءات الواجهة والتنقل. يبقى رسم النقاط والأشرطة الخاص بـ Utopia علامة للهوية وليس أيقونة للمكوّنات.

aiRules: Read this theme policy after the core semantic contract.
Do not apply Utopia brand restrictions to other themes unless their manifests say so.
Do not hardcode Brick Red, Special Black, TWK Lausanne, or Utopia icon rules inside reusable core components.
When Arabic or lang="ar" content is present, use --font-arabic mapped to Readex Pro and the Arabic display/body weight and line-height roles. Never apply Latin uppercase or letter-spacing to Arabic.
Arabic display sizing follows the Latin display scale at approximately 90-92%, rather than making Arabic headings larger than Latin headings. Arabic display line-height must be at least 1.28.
Do not apply Latin uppercase display styling to Arabic. Use Arabic display/body tokens and text-transform: none.
When this theme is active, use Phosphor Icons for interface actions and navigation; do not mix icon families.
Modal content uses --modal-surface and must stay solid in Utopia Default; only the overlay dims the page behind it.
Floating content such as select, menu, popover, and tooltip uses --popover-surface so alpha page surfaces do not make controls look translucent.
